method: One source-bound native CorrectiveSmooth20x1.0 construction at each mirrored rear-knee peak, multiplied by a fixed C1 posterior knee collar, exact inverse per-vertex LBS, then C1 25mm source saturation. Rear knee keys use lunge amount; shoulder keys use side-kick amount. All four keys are explicit in both actions, unrelated targets zero. No DQ runtime or pose change.
